# ColorCorrectionEffect

- Inherits [`PostEffect`](posteffect.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")`

Adjusts the color of the whole picture: its brightness, contrast, saturation and tint. It is applied to the exposed image before tone mapping, so a highlight it brightens still rolls off smoothly instead of clipping.

Every enabled one is applied, in order: the children of `Lighting` first, then the camera's. Each applies its tint, then its saturation, then its contrast, then its brightness.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Brightness` | `number` | `0` | read/write | An amount of light added to every pixel, from -1 to 1. The average of a frame is about 0.45 after exposure, so 0.1 is a gentle lift and -0.2 is clearly darker. The darkest pixels stop at black. |
| `Contrast` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How far every pixel is pushed away from the frame's average brightness, from -1 to 1. At 0 nothing changes, at 0.5 the difference grows by half, and at -1 the picture is flattened to a single gray. |
| `Saturation` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How vivid colors are, from -1 to 1. -1 is black and white, 0 changes nothing, and 1 doubles the distance of each color from gray. |
| `TintColor` | `Color3` | `Color3.new(1, 1, 1)` | read/write | A color the picture is multiplied by. White changes nothing; a warm white warms the picture. |
